summary: Evaxion A/S, a Danish clinical-stage biotech, filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, furnishing a press release about expanding and refocusing its R&D pipeline with EVX-05, an AI-designed off-the-shelf glioblastoma vaccine, while discontinuing the EVX-03 program. No financial terms, transactions, or board actions are disclosed. The filing is a routine pipeline update, not a special situation. The company maintains cash runway into H2 2027. What to watch: clinical progress and partnership developments with Duke University School of Medicine.
